description: Mathlib-free reconstruction of V0.9-R case R1b. OAI.Problem335.ceilDiv from the OpenAI comparator corpus (commit 4eaee875, DepthFive challenge) against the textbook ceiling formula, on the domain where the challenge uses it (t = ceilSqrt n, n >= 2, hence t > 0).
preamble:
def ceilSqrt (n : Nat) : Nat := Nat.sqrt n + if (Nat.sqrt n) ^ 2 = n then 0 else 1
def ceilDiv (n t : Nat) : Nat := (n + t - 1) / t
reference: n / t + (if n % t = 0 then 0 else 1)
reference_source: textbook: ceil(n/t) = floor(n/t) + [t does not divide n], meaningful for t > 0

agree_domain: intro n t h; exact ceilDiv_formula n t (by rw [h.2]; exact ceilSqrt_pos n h.1)

lemmas:
theorem ceilSqrt_pos (n : Nat) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : 0 < ceilSqrt n := by
  unfold ceilSqrt
  split
  · rename_i h
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Nat.sqrt n) with h0 | h0
    · rw [h0] at h; simp at h; omega
    · omega
  · omega

theorem ceilDiv_formula (n t : Nat) (tpos : 0 < t) :
    ceilDiv n t = n / t + (if n % t = 0 then 0 else 1) := by
  unfold ceilDiv
  have hdm := Nat.div_add_mod n t
  have hlt := Nat.mod_lt n tpos
  split
  · have e : n + t - 1 = (t - 1) + t * (n / t) := by omega
    rw [e, Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ tpos, Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega)]; omega
  · have e : n + t - 1 = (n % t - 1) + t * (n / t + 1) := by rw [Nat.mul_add]; omega
    rw [e, Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ tpos, Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega)]; omega
